tui.release_confirm.title: Release now
tui.release_confirm.tests_passed: Tests: the last test run passed
tui.release_confirm.tests_failed: Tests: the last test run failed
tui.release_confirm.tests_none: Tests: no test run in this session
tui.release_confirm.branch_no_upstream: Branch {branch}: not pushed yet, it has no upstream
tui.release_confirm.branch_no_remote: Branch {branch}: no remote, so it is not pushed
tui.release_confirm.warning_hint: A warning does not stop the release. You decide.
tui.release_confirm.commit: Commit: no. smith makes no commit. It tags the current commit.
tui.release_confirm.push_no_remote: Push: no. There is no remote, so the tags stay on this computer.
tui.release_confirm.push_off: Push: no. The command line has --no-push.
tui.release_confirm.publish: Publish: yes. Each package goes to its registry.
tui.release_run.title: Releasing: {commandLine}
tui.release_run.working: smith publishes each package. This can take a while. Ctrl+C stops it.
tui.release_result.why_stopped: The release did not finish. The Run screen ({shortcutOf}) holds the output.
tui.release_result.next_pushed: What next: smith release --status shows what went where. CI builds the assets from the tags.
tui.release_result.next_local: What next: nothing left this computer. Add a remote and push the tags: git push --tags
tui.release_result.next_failed: What next: fix the cause in the output, then release again. Finished packages stay done and the rest go on.
tui.release_empty.nothing: Nothing to release: no feat: or fix: commits since the last tag
tui.release_empty.held: Nothing to release: you held back {list}, and no other package has a feat: or fix: commit.
tui.release_empty.no_package: Nothing to release: this workspace has no package. Apps and internal libraries are never released.
tui.release_empty.why_commits: Only feat: (a minor version) and fix: (a patch) commits make a release. A breaking commit makes a major version.
tui.release_empty.why_folder: A package releases when such a commit changes its own folder, or a library it imports.
tui.release_empty.why_chore: A chore: commit releases nothing. The commits smith makes itself, such as "chore: add app web", are chore: commits.
tui.release_empty.why_write: Write your work with a message such as "feat: add search" or "fix: handle empty input", then read this view again ({key}).
tui.release_empty.first_hint: This package was never released. This commit starts its history. Select the line to copy it.
tui.release_first.title: Create the first release commit
tui.release_first.why: This adds one empty commit to the current branch. It changes no file and pushes nothing. Undo it with git reset --soft HEAD~1.
tui.release_first.done: The first release commit exists. Reading the plan again.
tui.release_reason.nothing_to_explain: the plan has packages to release, so there is nothing to explain
tui.release_reason.no_first: no package waits for its first release
tui.release_preview.next: Release now ({key}) publishes them from here. Or push to the release branch and CI releases them.
